title: SaveAdHocQueryRequest
description: Request to create or update an ad-hoc query. Omit ID to create a new query; supply an existing ID to update it. name, query_view_id, and at least one select_fields entry are required.

id.description: ID of an existing saved query to update. Omit (or leave null) to create a new query; supply the existing ID to update it in place.

name.description: Display name of the query. Required.

description.description: Optional free-text description of the query.

query_view_id.description: ID of the query view the query runs against. Required. Stable across environments, so safe to embed in caller code.

folder_id.description: Folder to file the saved query under.

site_id.description: Site to scope the saved query to.

category_id.description: Category to file the saved query under.

default_data_form_id.description: Default data form to open results in.

others_can_modify.description: When true, other users may modify this saved query.

mobilize.description: When true, the query is available on mobile. Omitting this field leaves mobile availability unchanged on update; on create, an omitted value defaults to false.

is_favorite.description: When true, adds the query to the caller's favorites. False or omitted removes it from favorites; favorite status is reasserted on every save, so it must be resent on every update to persist.

suppress_duplicate_rows.description: Suppress duplicate full rows in the query's output.

run_security_level.description: Run-permission security level. AppFx security-level enum name, passed through verbatim (e.g. "SelectedRoles"). Pair with permissioned_run_roles.

edit_security_level.description: Edit-permission security level. AppFx security-level enum name, passed through verbatim (e.g. "SelectedRoles"). Pair with permissioned_edit_roles.

permissioned_run_roles.description: System roles granted or denied Run permission. Used when run_security_level restricts run access to selected roles.

permissioned_edit_roles.description: System roles granted or denied Edit permission. Used when edit_security_level restricts edit access to selected roles.

column_name.description: Column name on the object. Required.

filter_operator.description: Filter operator (e.g. IsEqualTo, IsOneOf, IsBlank, BeginsWith). Required for the row to be applied.

compare_type.description: Boolean connector to the previous filter (None, And, Or). The first filter typically uses None.

values.description: Comparison values. Most operators need one; IsOneOf / IsBetween need more.

data_type.description: Data type of the values (String, Integer, Date, Money, Boolean, Guid, etc.). Optional for most operators.

include_blanks.description: When true, blank values in the source pass the filter alongside the comparison.

is_id_set_field.description: True when this filter references an ID set (selection) rather than a scalar.

left_parenthesis_count.description: Number of opening parens to emit when nested deeper than one level.

right_parenthesis_count.description: Number of closing parens to emit when nested deeper than one level.

AdHocQueryFilterField.description: One element of filter_fields (a WHERE-clause predicate).

object_name.description: Object name the aggregate runs over.

AdHocQueryGroupFilterField.description: One element of group_filter_fields (a HAVING-clause predicate over an aggregate).

is_static.description: When true, the selection is static (materialized); false yields a dynamic selection.

use_in_query_designer.description: When true, the selection is shown in the Query Designer. Optional.

num_rows.description: Row count for a static selection. Optional; the server computes it when omitted.

id_set_id.description: ID of an existing selection (IDSETREGISTER.ID) to reuse; omit or leave empty to let the server assign one.

AdHocQueryIdSetInfo.description: Selection / ID-set options for a saved query. Providing this marks the query as producing a selection.

system_role_id.description: System role being granted or denied (SYSTEMROLE.ID).

grant_or_deny.description: True grants the role the permission; false denies it.

AdHocQueryPermissionedRole.description: A system-role grant or deny on a saved query's run or edit permission.

column_name.description: Column name on the object. Required.

parent_path.description: Query-view join path leading to the object. Required for every select field; for root-table fields it equals object_name (defaulted when omitted). For joined fields, supply the full backslash-delimited path (e.g. V_QUERY_CONSTITUENT\Interactions).

display_path.description: Human-readable join-path display. Used in error messages and output column captions; usually mirrors parent_path.

alias_name.description: Alias to apply to the output column. Optional; one is generated when omitted.

aggregate_type.description: Aggregate to apply (None, Count, Sum, Min, Max, Average).

is_id_set_field.description: True when this field references an ID set (selection) rather than a scalar column.

is_hidden.description: Suppresses the field from output while still allowing it to participate in filter/sort/group expressions.

AdHocQuerySelectField.description: One element of select_fields. Field names map 1:1 to the underlying query definition.

alias_name.description: Output-column alias to sort on. Either this or field_name must be supplied.

field_name.description: Raw field reference, typically in ObjectName.ColumnName form.

sort_order.description: Ascending or Descending. Defaults to Ascending when omitted.

AdHocQuerySortField.description: One element of sort_fields (an ORDER BY entry). Each sort field must reference a select field.
